detail.longDescription: Gitea 1.27.3 is now available! This third patch release for the 1.27 series includes important security fixes across Gitea Actions, the API, package registry, and repository migration, plus bug fixes for Actions, packages, and the UI. We strongly recommend upgrading as soon as possible. https:// blog.gitea.com/release-of-1.27 .3/ # gitea # opensource # devops # git
